consequence.statement: Environments using clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster deployments will now have correct behavior; previously this feature did not work as intended.
consequence.remediation: No action required; this is a bugfix that improves existing functionality.

original.statement: Support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster deployments was fixed in Istio 1.24.0.

decision.reason: [ev-4407ed95f094] only says that support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster was fixed. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, is ignored or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is supported. A fix that changes how configured exclusions behave at runtime is best classed as behavior-change (review) at low severity. The surrounding section context adds no failure or required step for this item.
